text: Account recovery when a phone is lost. Use a saved recovery code to sign in, then enroll a replacement device. Ask a workspace owner to verify your identity if no code remains.
Monthly billing invoices. Open Billing, select the billing month and choose Download PDF. Only billing administrators can access invoices.
API token rotation. Create a replacement token with the same scopes, deploy it to your clients, verify requests succeed, then revoke the previous token.
Invite a teammate. Workspace owners open Members and enter the teammate email address. An invitation expires after seven days and can be resent.
Export audit logs. In Security, open Audit Log, select a date range and choose CSV export. Only workspace owners can export the records.
Webhook retries use exponential backoff. Failed deliveries are retried after one minute, five minutes and thirty minutes. A successful response stops retries.
Enforce single sign-on. Verify the identity provider connection in a second browser session before enabling Require SSO. Keep an emergency owner recovery code offline.
Archive a project from Project Settings. Archived projects become read-only while their documents and history remain available. An owner can restore the project.
Configure audit retention in Security Settings. Select the retention period and save. The scheduled purge removes older events; exports already downloaded are unaffected.
API usage limits apply per workspace. Requests exceeding the limit return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Wait for that interval before retrying.
Change the billing contact in Billing Settings. Save the new email address and confirm it using the verification link. Future receipts go to the confirmed address.
Refresh an uploaded document by uploading its new version under the existing document ID. Indexing runs asynchronously. Wait for Ready status before evaluating retrieval.
